title: Gasoline Pumps and Loose Chickens in Austin
summary:
*   **No Loose Fowl:** An ordinance was passed prohibiting chickens and other fowl from running at large within city limits.
*   **Public Health Boost:** $1,000 was appropriated from the general fund to support the Public Health department.
*   **Early Gas Stations Approved:** Two permits were issued, allowing companies to install gasoline tanks under sidewalks and pumps at the curb. These permits included specific safety rules for modern pumps, lighting, hose storage, and were revocable.
